title: Deuteronomy Bible Quiz - Chapter 23
description: Ten questions on Deuteronomy 23: who may enter the assembly, a clean camp, runaway servants, interest and vows.

questions.text: Whom did the Ammonites and Moabites hire to curse Israel?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says they hired Balaam the son of Beor from Pethor of Mesopotamia to curse Israel.

questions.text: What did Yahweh do with the curse?
questions.explanation: Yahweh would not listen to Balaam, but turned the curse into a blessing, because he loved Israel.

answers.text: He sent it back on Moab
He made Balaam go silent forever
He turned it into a song
He turned it into a blessing

questions.text: Why were the Israelites not to abhor an Edomite?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says: "You shall not abhor an Edomite, for he is your brother."

answers.text: Because he gave them bread and water
Because he lived in their land

questions.text: Which generation born to the Edomites and Egyptians could enter Yahweh's assembly?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says the children of the third generation born to them may enter into Yahweh's assembly.

questions.text: When could a man who was unclean because of something that happened at night come back into the camp?
questions.explanation: When evening came he was to bathe in water, and when the sun was down he could come within the camp.

answers.text: When the sun was down, after bathing

questions.text: What were the Israelites to have among their weapons?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says they were to have a trowel among their weapons, to dig and cover their excrement.

questions.text: Why was the camp to be holy?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says Yahweh walks in the middle of the camp to deliver them and give up their enemies before them.

answers.text: Because the ark had to be washed
Because Yahweh walks in the middle of the camp
Because the priests lived outside it

questions.text: What were they to do with a servant who escaped from his master to them?
questions.explanation: They were not to hand him back to his master; he was to dwell among them in the place he chose, and they were not to oppress him.

answers.text: Let him live among them where he chose
Return him to his master at once
Make him serve the priests for a year

questions.text: From whom were the Israelites allowed to charge interest?
questions.explanation: Verse 20 says they may charge a foreigner interest, but not their brother.

questions.text: What does verse 22 say about choosing not to make a vow?
questions.explanation: Verse 22 says: "But if you refrain from making a vow, it shall be no sin in you."

answers.text: It is a sin that needs a sacrifice
It must be reported to the elders
